close_reason: Count fixed to 19. Citation to PLAN.md §'Method Coverage' added so the deliberate omission of Calendar/query and Calendar/queryChanges is discoverable.
description:
lib.rs:82 — the doc comment on register_calendars_handlers says:

  /// After this call, the dispatcher handles all 20 Calendars methods:

But only 19 reg! invocations exist (verified: grep -c 'reg!(' yields 19). The README method-coverage table at line 49 correctly says '19 method names'. PLAN.md §'Method Coverage' (line 95) also says 19, and explicitly flags this lib.rs doc as the 'minor doc bug, low priority'.

Either the doc count is wrong (most likely — fix to 19) or Calendar/query / Calendar/queryChanges were intended to be registered too. The PLAN.md §'Method Coverage' Note (lines 118-121) suggests Calendar/query / Calendar/queryChanges were left out deliberately: 'If they are needed, they would be registered alongside ...'.

Fix: change '20' to '19' in lib.rs:82.

P4 because nothing breaks from the wrong count; readability/doc-correctness only.
title: register_calendars_handlers doc says 'all 20' methods; only 19 registered
